model_contract.bounded_result_semantics: No witness means only that the explicitly enumerated finite cases were checked; it never proves the unbounded source statement.
model_contract.candidate_policy: Source-listed or otherwise encoded known examples are excluded from candidate output.
model_contract.counterexample_or_witness: p, A, determinant, and exhaustive nonzero-vector check
model_contract.objects: invertible matrices over prime fields F_p with p>=5
model_contract.premise: no vector x with all coordinates nonzero has Ax coordinatewise nonzero
model_contract.scope_limitation: The executor enumerates the explicitly named finite subfamily in model_contract.objects. A failure inside it is a valid source-level counterexample; no failure says nothing about objects outside it.
model_contract.source_statement: Conjecture If ${\mathbb F}$ is a finite field with at least 4 elements and $A$ is an invertible $n \times n$ matrix with entries in ${\mathbb F}$, then there are column vectors $x,y \in {\mathbb F}^n$ which have no coordinates equal to zero such that $Ax=y$.
